# Pre-registration: Isabelle theories of Tables 7 and 8 regenerated by the published generator

Written 26 October 2026, after the 30 theories were regenerated and before any Isabelle build ran.

## Why

Section 5.5 currently states that the SRanger and LRE theories of Table 7 and all theories of Table 8
were generated under the earlier environment model (invariant pins `offered` to the listen set) and are
reported as collected. To report one pipeline version throughout, the Isabelle theories of those runs
are regenerated by the published generator (Forge 459e4f68) from each run's recorded RoboChart model
(`robochart_model.xmi` at the converged iteration) and proved. The runs' Java, Dafny and FDR4 results
and their iteration counts are not touched.

## Inputs

25 runs, 30 theories: `convergence-v3-frozen/{sranger,lre}/run-1..5` (10 theories),
`ablation-d2-diagnostic/{sranger,lre}/run-1..5` (10), `multicontroller-e/chemical_detector/run-1..5`
(10: GasAnalysis and Movement). Check already made: every regenerated theory has the same set of
transition operations as the recorded one, plus one `Idle_<State>` per state, and an unpinned invariant.

## Procedure

`verify30.sh`: one Isabelle session per theory, `-o timeout=600`, 4 threads, Movement theories built one
at a time; verdicts `verified` / `proof_failed` / `goal_timeout` (inconclusive); MEMKILL, UNKNOWN and
DOCKERDOWN are environment rows and are rebuilt.

## Reporting rule

- All 30 verify: the regenerated theories replace the recorded ones as the reported Isabelle artefacts of
  those runs (the recorded ones are kept beside them as `isabelle-collected/`), and Section 5.5's
  paragraph on the earlier environment model is replaced by one sentence saying that every reported
  theory carries the environment model described there. Table 8's lemma counts are updated.
- Any theory fails: the failure is reported as a result in Section 4.6/4.7 for that run, the run's
  convergence status is re-examined, and the paragraph stays, restated for the runs affected.
- Goal timeouts are inconclusive, never kills or passes; they are rerun at a higher cap before reporting.

## Expectation

All 30 verify: the seven probe theories and the 166 campaign theories built under this environment
model all did, and the regenerated theories differ from those only in the controller instance.

## Outcome (26 October 2026)

All 30 theories verify (28 at the 600 s per-goal cap; SRanger run 3 after a JVM start-up fault in the
container, 37 s on rerun; LRE run 1 after a goal timeout at 600 s, verified at the 1,800 s cap in
1,301 s). The vacuity audit's environment-aware check reports nothing on the 30. Adopt rule applied:
the regenerated theories are installed as each run's `formal-artefacts/isabelle/` with build logs, the
collected theories kept in `isabelle-collected/`; Section 5.5's paragraph replaced by one sentence;
Table 2 (25/47 lemmas), Table 8's note (84 to 96 lemmas) and 5.6(f) updated; R2-4 aligned.
